title.zh: 幅度相同，位置可以不同

t.zh: 重建器可以检验“频率有多少”是否足够。现在交换两张图的幅度来源和相位来源，检查空间结构跟随哪一部分。只在非零系数上讨论相位，零系数的方向没有意义。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Use the synthesiser to test whether frequency amounts alone suffice. Mix magnitude and phase sources and inspect spatial structure. Phase is meaningful for nonzero coefficients; zero coefficients have no direction. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

after.zh:
\[C[k]=|C[k]|e^{i\phi_k}\]

|C[k]| 是该频率的系数长度，φk 是相位。长度决定贡献多大，相位决定它在各位置如何对齐；因此两张图即使频谱幅度相同，也可能有不同排列。零系数没有可保留的相位，保护除数也不能凭空创造它。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
after.en:
\[C[k]=|C[k]|e^{i\phi_k}\]

|C[k]| is coefficient length and φk its phase. Length controls contribution size; phase controls spatial alignment. Images with identical spectral magnitudes can therefore have different arrangements. A zero coefficient has no phase to preserve, and protecting a denominator cannot invent one. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 把每对频率系数缩放到给定长度，保持实部与虚部的比例和符号。两分量同为 0 时仍输出 0；用给定下限保护除数。
brief.en: Rescale each coefficient pair to the supplied length while retaining its component ratio and signs. A zero pair stays zero; use the supplied floor to protect division.

after.zh:
\[C_{\mathrm{new}}=C\,\frac{m}{\max(|C|,\varepsilon)}\]

m 是目标系数长度，ε 是给定的正下限。共同缩放两个分量可保持方向；当 |C|≥ε 时得到目标长度，保护下限生效时长度可能更小。C=0 仍为 0，因为零向量没有可保留的相位。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
after.en:
\[C_{\mathrm{new}}=C\,\frac{m}{\max(|C|,\varepsilon)}\]

m is the requested length and ε the supplied positive floor. Scaling both parts together preserves direction. The target length is reached when |C|≥ε; an active floor can reduce it. C=0 stays zero because a zero vector has no phase to preserve. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

naiveWhy.zh: 长度由向量长度元件计算。比例取决于目标长度与当前长度；把两个分量一起改变，观察负号是否保留。
naiveWhy.en: The length component supplies current magnitude. Scaling depends on desired versus current length; change both components together and inspect retained signs.

t.zh: 频率系数的两分量共同确定长度与方向。同一个正比例同时作用于实部和虚部，会改变长度而保留方向；零系数没有可保留的方向。先在系数表上验证，再交换图像的幅度和相位。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
t.en: A coefficient pair determines length and direction together. One positive scale changes length while retaining direction; a zero pair has no direction to preserve. Verify coefficient rescaling before exchanging image magnitudes and phases. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 长度由向量长度元件计算。比例取决于目标长度与当前长度；把两个分量一起改变，观察负号是否保留。
hint.en: The length component supplies current magnitude. Scaling depends on desired versus current length; change both components together and inspect retained signs.

brief.zh: 重建时保留 B 的相位关系，使用 A 的频谱幅度。把 B 的两分量一起缩放到 A 的系数长度；零长度使用给定安全下限 10⁻¹²。 B 中的零系数保留为零。
brief.en: Reconstruct using B’s phase relationships and A’s magnitudes. Scale both B components together to A’s coefficient lengths; use the supplied 10⁻¹² floor for zero lengths. Zero coefficients in B remain zero.

t.zh: 系数缩放已能保留方向。现在把它接在两台频谱仪之后：从一张图取得目标幅度，从另一张图保留相位关系，再交给已验证的重建器。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Coefficient rescaling now retains direction. Apply it after two spectrum analysers: take desired magnitudes from one image, preserve phase relationships from the other, and use the earned synthesiser. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

naiveWhy.zh: 把幅度当作全部实部并把虚部设零，会人为指定所有相位，而不是保留 B 的空间关系。
naiveWhy.en: Using magnitudes as real components and zero imaginary components imposes phases instead of retaining B’s spatial relationships.

hint.zh: 同一比例缩放实部和虚部会改变长度而保持方向。先比较平移前后的同一形状。
hint.en: Scaling both components equally changes length but preserves direction. Start by comparing a shape with its translation.
